Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
Hey, any interesting TV shows lately？
Hm？ I thought ▲高嶺＊＊▲ had TV rules...
Yes, the shows I can watch are set, but...
If there's a show you think is interesting, I thought I'd ask if I could watch just that one.
I see.
But it'd help if you left out variety shows...
Oh, and romance dramas are a bit...
A serious quiz show, or a cooking show, might be easier to ask for.
What do you think？
(Honestly, that's pretty tough...)
Takane
Remember when you told me about some interesting TV shows？
Yeah, I remember. How'd it go？
I asked Mama first, and she asked Papa for me, but...
That started a fight.
Uh-oh. Your dad's hard to convince, huh.
No, actually, Papa ended up with bigger problems.
How come？
Mama, who's always smiling, stopped talking to him, and he got really depressed...
It was my fault to begin with, so I apologized and told Mama, "Forget about the TV."
But she said that's not the issue anymore. And Papa comes to me for advice too. What should I do...
(This has gone somewhere crazy...)
Hey, have your parents made up since then？
Takane
Hmm... Not completely yet.
I see...
Oh, but they said okay to the cooking show. It's only once a week, so they figured it's fine.
Hey, you did it！
Hehe, thanks. It's thanks to your help.
But why haven't they made up？
Because Papa doesn't understand why Mama got mad, she says.
Apparently Papa said something he shouldn't have... but he has no idea what.
Mama and I keep saying, "Why are men like that？" Looks like it'll go on a while longer.
(I'd better be careful too...)
Is there peace in the Takane house？
Takane
Yes, finally. Sorry for all the fuss.
So, did they figure out the cause？
Seems like it... but Mama won't tell me.
Why not？
She says it's their secret. She was gushing about it.
This was the first time, so I panicked... but they said it's nice once in a while, so maybe I worried for nothing.
Haha, I see. But it's good that they reconciled.
Yes. Seeing how lovey-dovey they are now, I've started thinking fights might be nice too？
W-Wait...
Hehe, kidding. Let's always get along, okay？
Takane
Hey, do you know much about cell phones？
Eh？ Why？
Papa wants to change his ringtone, and he asked me, but...
I don't know much either, so I couldn't figure it out.
What about the manual？
We can't find it anywhere. It should be stored somewhere with everything else.
He can't even change it the normal way, and he wants a different ringtone for each person？
Sigh. Maybe I'll look for the manual a bit more...
(Sounds like a high bar...)
By the way, did you find the phone manual？
Takane
No. But we managed to change it to one of the ringtones already on the phone.
How？
We fiddled with it together. But setting one for each person was still impossible.
I see...
I said, why not take it to the store？ But he doesn't want to.
...Because it'd mean losing？
How did you know？ He insists he'll do it himself no matter what.
There's no point being stubborn about that. Right？
(Is ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s competitiveness genetic？)
How's the phone conquest going？
Takane
I managed it.
Oh, as expected. Now your dad can relax.
Well...
He got even more stubborn.
Ahh...
I understand how he feels, so I couldn't push him.
Even if he finds the manual, I bet he'll never look at it now. I wonder if he's sulking today too...
(The bar just got even higher... Tough.)
How's your dad doing since then？
Takane
Actually, Mama changed it without saying anything.
Eh!?
And while Papa was surprised, she quickly explained how, and that was that.
...He didn't blow up？
No. She handed him the phone, "Here," and he said thank you, like a good boy.
Huh... From everything you've said, that's kind of surprising.
Mama says, "In cases like this, you just hit them hard." She called it shock therapy, and maybe she's right.
So your mom knew how？
She found the manual a few days ago and memorized it. Anyway, case closed, I guess？
(Could I learn from how her mom handled it？)
Takane
Oh, right. I need to return the recipe book to Miki.
Miki？
Yes. Haven't I told you about her？
Nope, first I've heard.
I see. She's a friend from grade school. We went to different high schools, but we still keep in touch.
She said she had a recipe book she bought and never looked at, so I borrowed it.
Never looked at... So it's basically new？
Yes. She says she's satisfied just owning it.
I don't get that feeling. We're so different, it's fun to talk. Hehe.
(Total opposites, huh？)
Takane
The other day, I met up with Miki.
Ah, the friend who's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s total opposite.
Hehe, yes. I went to return the book, and she brought a different recipe book.
Huh. Don't tell me, brand new again？
No, she tried it a few times. But she failed every time.
So she asked me to coach her. So I'm going to try making it myself first.
Coach？
Yes. She wants to make pudding for someone she likes. So I'm helping. Hehe.
I see. Hope it works out. Good luck, coach.
Okay, I'll do my best▼
Did the pudding lesson go okay？
Takane
Hmm...
Huh？ Failed？
I knew she'd always been bad at cooking, but...
It was a little beyond what I imagined... I think？
W-What happened？
How did it turn out like that？ If I can just find the cause, I'm sure I can fix it...！
(She really is ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s total opposite...)
Did you find out what caused the pudding disaster？
Takane
No, not at all. Thinking didn't help, so we just made batch after batch... I don't want pudding for a while.
You ate that much... So how did it turn out in the end？
Yes, we got it to a passing level？ She's probably giving it to him about now.
I see. Well, good work.
Hehe, thank you. Hey, will you throw me a good-work party？
Sure. Anywhere you want to go？
I want cake▼
What！ Weren't you done with sweets for a while？
That was pudding. Cake is different？
Is that right...
That's right. Hehe, let's go！
(Girls are amazing...)
Takane
My neighbor's dog had puppies a little while ago.
Oh, how many？
Five, I think？ And they said they'll let me meet them soon.
That's something to look forward to.
Yes, so much. They said they're round and roly-poly, so cute you could eat them up！
Yesterday I was imagining all sorts of things and couldn't sleep.
But even though I didn't sleep, I'm not sleepy！ It's so strange.
(I bet it'll catch up with her tonight.)
Takane
I can't wait for the day to come...
You still haven't met the puppies？
No. It's still a delicate time. They can't leave the house yet.
I see. By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, were you okay that day we talked about this？
Huh, what do you mean？
Remember, you said you didn't sleep but weren't sleepy？ What happened after that？
...Well. I was so sleepy when I got home, and I held out until dinner somehow...
But I ran out of steam partway through and fell asleep. Like a little kid.
And Papa even recorded it on video... I want to delete it, but he hid it.
Papa and Mama said it was cute, but it's embarrassing, right？
I have to look for it again when I get home.
(I'd rather see that than the puppies...)
By the way, when do you get to meet the puppies？
Takane
I still haven't met them. But yesterday I talked with my neighbor a bit...
She said, "They're so healthy and rambunctious now, it might be tough for you, Manaka！"
She showed me pictures too！ They're so roly-poly！ And then...
▲高嶺＊＊▲, you didn't sleep last night either, did you？
！ ...How did you know？
Well, you know... I can tell.
...I'm just looking forward to it so much. I can't help it.
(What's going to happen when she actually meets them？)
How were the puppies？
Takane
Well. I played all day, and before I knew it, it was morning.
What!?
I played so much... and then I fell asleep with them, I guess.
The mother dog lay down next to me too, she said.
She didn't have the heart to wake me, so she called Mama... and I stayed over.
And she even took a picture.
I want to see！
No. I was sleeping with a face like a little kid. It's embarrassing.
But it was fun. She said to come see them again, so maybe I'll go after a while.
(Guess that's the last I'll see of ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s hyper mode for a while...？)
Takane
Do you know any Russian dishes？
Russian... Like piroshki？ Why？
Lately I've been into foreign cooking. And right now it's Russian.
Huh, did you make anything？
Yes. Boiled dumplings called pelmeni. The filling has ground meat, onion, and potato.
Potato in dumplings？ Sounds kind of like a croquette.
Hehe. You boil them, pour a sour cream sauce on top, and done.
Sounds good...
It was delicious？ Papa even had seconds.
I want some too...
Hehe, someday, okay？ What should I make next...
Takane
Do you know "Jansson's Temptation"？
Huh？ What's that？
Hehe, it's the name of a dish.
Oh, the foreign food boom's still going.
Ding-ding. It's Swedish.
Huh, what kind of dish？
To put it simply, a gratin？
You layer potatoes, sauteed onions, and anchovies, pour on cream and milk, then into the oven.
...Sounds good.
Hehe, it was delicious▼
Where should I cook from next？
(Lucky！)
Is the foreign food boom still going？
Takane
Yes. Right now I'm trying French.
It's called pommes soufflees, a fried side served with the main course. It's fun？
Whoa. Sounds fancy.
The potato puffs up like a balloon, so it's fun to watch, but it's really hard...
If you don't watch the cut, the oil temperature, and how you stir it while frying, it fails right away.
Potato？
Yes. I can't get it 100%, but it works pretty often now, so I'm satisfied for now.
Time to look for the next recipe.
(Hmm, something's bugging me...)
How's the cooking going？
Takane
It's settled down？ I finished with gnocchi. Flour and potato...
Hey, something's been bugging me. Why is it always potatoes？
...You noticed？
Yeah, around the something-souffle, kind of.
Actually, my aunt sent us a huge amount. We shared some, but there's still tons.
So you tried making all kinds of dishes.
Right. But my repertoire grew, and I like potatoes anyway, so it was good for me.
"For you"？
Papa and Mama said they've had enough for a while. So I ate yesterday's gnocchi mostly by myself.
It was delicious, too. Too bad.
(Potatoes for almost a month, so yeah...)
Takane
The other day, I ran into an old lady from our clinic, and we ended up talking for ages.
Huh, a patient.
And as we talked, more people gathered... until there were about seven.
All patients at ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s clinic？
Most of them, I think？
So they all knew me... It was embarrassing, they told stories from when I was little.
And then it turned into talk about my future husband.
If Mama hadn't come looking for me, I think we'd still be talking. They had so much energy.
(I can picture it...)
Takane
Remember I told you about the chatty old ladies？
Yeah, I remember. Don't tell me they caught you again？
Geez, "caught." I got home earlier than last time？
Haha, I see. You look kind of down, though.
Yes... About that...
She told me, "Come marry my grandson"...
What!?
Of course I think it was a joke, and I said no right away. But she was really pushy about meeting him once.
Sigh. What do I do...
(That's a problem for me too！)
...So, what happened with that？
Takane
With what？ Oh！
...I'm going to visit her house, just once.
What!?
Mama and I are going to go meet the grandson.
...But, the marriage thing...
That's fine. ...I think？
You think!?
Yes, Mama will be there. So don't worry？
(Whaaat!?)
▲高嶺＊＊▲... By the way, what happened with that grandson？
Takane
Oh！ Right, sorry. I haven't told you yet.
I found out why she pushed so hard？
Eh？
He really took to me... When he wouldn't let go of my hand, I didn't know what to do.
Your hand...
Hehe, he's a baby, so it can't be helped.
Huh... A baby？
Yes. Her grandson is so cute, she wanted me to come see him.
So, it's all settled. Sorry for worrying you.
(...Was that lady maybe a little serious, though？)
Takane
Magazines really come in all kinds, don't they？
At a big bookstore they've even got ones that make you go, "Seriously？"
Yes. Fashion magazines are even split by age... I can't tell from the titles, so it's confusing.
Ah, like teens, twenties, thirties.
Right. And the other day I saw the term "around-40" for the first time.
...What does that mean？
It means people around forty. Hehe, strange term, isn't it？
But maybe I'll try learning a bunch while I'm at it？
Once I learn them, I'll quiz you too. Let's study together？
(Does this count as studying？)
Takane
Here's a question.
Hm？ Oh, fashion terms？ Okay, bring it.
"Around-30."
Around-40 was around forty... so around thirty？
Ding-ding！ Next. "B-style."
B-style...？ Not blood type, right？
Bzzt！ Then, "consa."
...Consomme for dinner tonight？
Hehe, that sounds nice！
The answers: B-style is hip-hop fashion, and consa is conservative, elegant fashion. Or so they say.
So, too bad. Hehe.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is really studying hard.)
Did you master the new terms？
Takane
Yes. But I narrowed down the magazines I read, so I don't need them as much now.
Hm？ So before, you were reading everything you could find？
Yes. Because I didn't know which ones to look at.
Wasn't that tough？ Fashion magazines aren't that cheap.
That part was fine. I borrowed all my study magazines from the library.
Huh, the library has those？
I was surprised at first too, but they even have manga, you know？
Maybe next time I'll secretly borrow some manga...
(Is manga banned at ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s house too？)
So, how's the fashion thing going lately？
Takane
Yes, I've looked at so many that at least my eye's gotten better？
Putting it into practice is hard. There are things I want, but my allowance only goes so far.
If I could get a part-time job, maybe, but that's not really possible.
I see.
Lately, it's fun looking at cosmetics features too, not just clothes.
Before, I really wasn't interested...
I feel like my world's gotten bigger since I met you. Thank you.
(Maybe I could say the same...)
Takane
When you're cleaning, don't you always end up stopping？
Ah, like looking through photo albums.
Hehe. Were you watching me？
Bull's-eye, huh...
I had too much stuff, so I was organizing, and then my childhood albums came out... and I just stopped.
I get it, I get it.
By the time I shook off the temptation it was late, so I barely got anything done. I'll try again another day.
Won't you get hooked on something else next time？
Geez, don't predict weird things.
...Because I feel like it'll come true.
(Oh, it will...)
So？ How's the cleaning coming？
Takane
...It's your fault.
W-What is？
I found the diary I kept in grade school.
And my calligraphy pieces, my ballet shoes... all sorts of things.
So it was all temptation.
Yes. But I took them all to a different room, so next time it'll be fine！
...Probably. Yes.
(I wonder...)
Done tidying？
Takane
No, not yet.
Uh-oh. What tempted you this time？
While I was moving things around, Mama came to check on me, and we got to talking.
I see...
But it was fun. We talked about lots of things.
...Girl talk we can't do in front of Papa, too.
So, stuff you can't talk about in front of me either？
Of course. Girls have lots of things.
...Could it be about me？
Hmm, who knows？ It's a secret▼
(Now I'm curious...)
How's the cleaning going？
Takane
Yes. I'm almost done. It's much tidier now.
I see, good work.
Thanks. Now there's room for more stuff.
Got plans for something？
Yes, little by little from now on. I wanted to make space for it.
Hmm？
Because things with memories of you will keep piling up.
Huh？ Do we have that many...？
I do！ Hehe！
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ do anything before bed？
Takane
Before bed... I do some light stretching, I guess？
Stretching？ Why？
Why, I wonder？ I've always done it, since forever.
I feel like it helps me sleep.
Doesn't ▲高嶺＊＊▲ fall asleep fast without that？
...It's different whether I do it or not？ Just a little.
How so？
Well, you know... Oh, if anything, I wake up feeling good... I think！
Yes, that's it. So it's better to do it. You should do it too？ Definitely.
(So it doesn't really do much？)
Takane
Since you said that, I tried skipping my stretches before bed, you know？
Huh, you stopped？
Yes. Because I was curious if it works.
Well, I got restless and it took a long time to fall asleep.
It's been my habit since grade school, so I couldn't settle down...
So it does work.
...Oh, right.
Huh？
！ Um, yes, that's right！ Now you see that it works, right？ Right？
(She only just noticed...)
Takane
Last night I read a novel for the first time in ages.
Ah, before bed.
Yes. Somehow, I just drifted off. Maybe faster than with stretching.
Works like a charm.
But this morning I didn't wake up feeling great.
Haha, then stretching is best for ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Maybe so. Maybe doing something different is the problem...
Habits are a thing, sure, but trying different stuff is good too, right？ A little, at least.
You think？ ...Okay, maybe I'll try that.
Takane
Last night, I was looking at the stars by myself.
Before bed？
Yes. They were so pretty. I wanted to tell you, but it was late.
I see. I wish I'd looked too.
I sent you telepathy. Didn't it reach you？
Sadly, no.
Hehe. Then practice so you can receive it next time？
How？
Like, thinking about me before you go to sleep？ Just kidding...
With weather like this, the stars should be pretty tonight too. Let's look together tonight, okay？
What does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ do to blow off steam？
Takane
Blow off steam？ Hmm... Bake bread, I guess？
Bread？
Yes. It's really refreshing？ When you punch the air out, you can go WHAM！ as hard as you want.
When I'm doing that, Papa and Mama never come near. Hehe.
Now I want to make some, it's been a while. I'll bring you some when I bake it？
(What kind of face does she make while doing it...)
Thanks for the bread the other day.
Takane
You're welcome. Thanks to you, I really got it out of my system.
So... a lot of WHAM？
Hehe, maybe. Nobody came into the kitchen.
O-Oh...
I asked Mama once, "Why don't you ever come in？"
And what did she say？
She said I'm scary. I go WHAM！ with a totally blank face, apparently.
But doesn't everyone look like that when they're serious about something？ What do you think？
(Hmm, I wonder...)
Takane
Oh, right. Hey, I'm thinking of baking bread again. Any requests？
Huh.
Hm？
No... Just wondering if you're blowing off steam again.
Hehe, nope. Mama bought a natural yeast starter, so we're making it together.
Natural yeast？
Yes. It's what makes the bread rise, and I love bread made with natural yeast.
Huh... There's a lot to it.
Yes, so much it's hard. But once you get picky about ingredients, there's no end.
Making something reasonably delicious is my rule, I guess？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is so sensible about that stuff.)
How was baking bread with your mom？
Takane
Well？ I totally understood what Mama meant by a blank face.
Eh？
Hehe. Because...
Mama had a blank face too！ When she went WHAM！
The moment I saw it, I thought, oh, that's it. It really is kind of scary.
That much？
Yes. So I can never make bread for you, ever...
R-Really？
Kidding▼ Hehe！
Takane
What's the latest you've ever stayed up？
Hmm, I wonder... Why？
Well. I thought I'd try testing my limit.
What for？
...If, just if, okay？
Someday, when we can stay out all night, it'd be bad if I couldn't stay awake, right？
Ah, I see... But forcing it won't do any good, will it？
Besides, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ can't really stay up late, can she？
...That's why I'm practicing now.
Could you teach me some tricks？ Then I'm sure I can manage. So, please？
(Tricks？ Are there any？)
Takane
Hey, I can't stay up at night...
Well, you can't do it in just a week or so.
Sigh...
...Ah！ Hey, what if I exercise？ I'd be wide awake and could stay up, right？
I think it'd backfire. You'd get tired and sleepy.
...You think？
Yeah. You just have to stretch it out bit by bit.
Right. ...Okay, I'll do my best.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ never spares any effort, no matter what it's for.)
So？ Can you stay up longer now？
Takane
A little longer！ One hour！
Oh, nice, nice.
Hehe. I still get sleepy at the same time, though.
Huh. Really？
Yes. I just learned to hold out from there.
I nod off and sometimes bump my head on the desk and startle myself, though...
But it's a new record. Hehe！
(I don't think that counts as staying up...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, how's it going？ Can you stay up later？
Takane
Mm... I think I'll stop. It doesn't seem to suit me.
Did something happen？
...Remember I told you I nod off and bump my head？
Yeah, you did.
I did it again yesterday... and the noise startled Papa and Mama so much they came rushing into my room.
And I got scolded. They said forcing yourself to stay up does no good, so stop.
You said that at the start too, didn't you？
Yeah. And lack of sleep is bad for your skin. If ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s beautiful skin got rough...
...Hehe. Yes, so I'll sleep properly.
When we can stay out all night, I'll try my best then. Cheer me on then？
Of course！
Takane
Hey, what I'm about to tell you is a secret from everyone, okay？
S-Sure. What？
Well？ I've started reading manga.
Huh, isn't manga banned at ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s house too？
No one's said it outright, but I think it is. So I read it secretly at the library.
I see... What are you reading？
A tennis manga with a girl as the heroine. It's pretty old, but it's so good.
Once I started, I couldn't stop... I forgot to eat dinner.
The glutton ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ That's amazing...
Right？ Ah, I want to read the rest soon.
(No reaction to "glutton"... Manga power is amazing...)
Did you get further in the manga？
Takane
Well？ Someone seems to have borrowed it, so I haven't been able to read it yet.
I see. So what's happening in it now？
The heroine is getting special training from a really strict coach.
"Coach, I can't do it anymore！"
"...Anyone who whines has no place in my tennis club. Go home！"
"But... tennis is all I have..."
That's where it stopped. Hey, don't you want to know what happens？
(It even has ▲高嶺＊＊▲ doing a one-woman show... Manga power is terrifying.)
Is the manga back？
Takane
Yes. It came back, but...
Hm？
I don't really want to read the rest.
Huh, why？ You were looking forward to it so much.
If I keep reading at this pace, it'll be over soon...
In the manga, the coach and the heroine look like they're going to be separated, too.
When I finish, I'll be saying goodbye to the manga too...
If I'd known it'd feel this sad, I wouldn't have started.
Sigh...
(She's so hooked... I kind of want to read it.)
How's the manga？ Did you keep reading？
Takane
Yes. I couldn't hold back after all.
How did it end？
Happy ending. The coach who went abroad comes back to the heroine...
I was so moved I cried quietly in the library. Hehe.
People who can come up with stories like that are amazing, aren't they？ I couldn't.
Want to read another manga？
Hmm. If there's a good one. Do you know any？
Hmm, maybe a few？
Then next time... Oh, but it's a secret from everyone, okay？ And that I cried too. Okay？
(In a way, I've got something on her now？)
